posts.text: Why Traders Under Financial Pressure Struggle to Master Trading Psychology — I’ve been in the markets for 10 years and have spent the last 6 years teaching trading psychology. Through my experience working with traders, I’ve noticed a pattern that I believe deserves serious attention. There are four situations in which mastering trading psychology becomes significantly more difficult: 1. Traders who borrow money to trade.
